title: Cluster callouts from accepted proposals and cluster JSON
description:
As a reader, I want a short list of new and growing themes with item counts and top terms, so that I can see what is emerging.

```gherkin
Feature: Emerging cluster callouts
  Scenario: Accepted cluster shown
    Given a cluster with a stable uid that the desk accepted and named
    Then the callout shows the name, item count, top terms and a sparkline

  Scenario: Unaccepted cluster
    Given a cluster the desk has not accepted
    Then it is hidden or shown as unnamed according to the publication setting

  Scenario: Public-safe
    Then the cluster JSON contains ids, names, counts, series and terms only

  Scenario: Not enough data
    Given a cluster with fewer than 4 weeks of data
    Then no New, Growing or Cooling label is shown
```
